observations.symptom: Adding a direct OverlayLib project reference while keeping transitive project references enabled caused duplicate OverlayLib static web asset keys during DiscoverPrecompressedAssets.
observations.repair: Set DisableTransitiveProjectReferences=true in the sandbox project and kept explicit direct references, including OverlayLib, so asset ownership is not duplicated.

observations.symptom: The layout-composition fixed Row/Column example used max-content tracks and produced internal horizontal overflow under desktop measurement.
observations.repair: Replaced max-content tracks with bounded minmax(0, fr) tracks.

observations.symptom: The Row/Column examples left a large empty gradient area on mobile because forced two-row grid tracks stretched content rows beyond their natural height.
observations.repair: Removed forced Rows="2" on the Row/Column examples so rows size to content.
